verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows domain/path filtering for search (includeDomains/excludeDomains, path prefixes) but never documents a crawl mode that follows subpages or traverses an entire site starting from a search result — no mention of a 'subpages' parameter, sitemap traversal, or recursive fetch capability. missing for 10: any documentation or example of crawling subpages/whole sites from a result, evidence of a crawl depth/breadth control, or a hands-on report of this behavior.
